title: アオハル杯4戦目にむけて・強敵の予感

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, it's time for the fourth preseason match of the Unity Cup!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Breathe in… breathe out… and focus!
choice_data_list: Looks like you're ready to go!
Looks like you're ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mm-hm, I want to be extra prepared. We're going up against an undefeated team, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: They must be really good, if they've never lost…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So I've got to try my absolute hardest today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yep! Hehe… I'm nervous, but I may also be getting a little… excited.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I think, um… it'd probably make everyone really happy if we won today's match.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Our opponents might be tough, but we've all been training really hard for this, so we're all really tough too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's why… I know we'll be fine. We've done it so many times in practice, haven't we? So now… We just have to do it for real!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll do my very best!
